notes: Resident population from Iran's 2016 census by official municipal district (mantaqeh) — genuine intra-city subdivisions. No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model with no real O/D anchor. Note: a district-numbering ambiguity in the original source table initially mapped population meant for a differently-named district onto the wrong polygon, leaving a real, populated district at zero population; this was corrected after an in-game report, and is mentioned here as a data-handling error that was caught and fixed, not as an ongoing issue.
sources: amar.org.ir (Statistical Center of Iran), 2016 census by mantaqeh
